skill.name: Agent Session Auto-Tracking Setup
skill.description: Initialize and configure automatic session tracking for an agent workflow, where the session lifecycle is managed implicitly from agent instantiation until application termination without explicit session management calls.
skill.skill_body:
Create an agent instance and invoke its methods. The session will be automatically tracked from instantiation until the application exits. No explicit session start or stop calls are required.

## Objective

Set up implicit session tracking for agent-based applications
## Applicable Signals

- Agent class instantiation
- Workflow entry point execution
- No explicit session management code present

## Contraindications

- Explicit multi-session management is required
- Manual session lifecycle control is needed
- Session isolation across concurrent workflows is critical
- Custom session lifecycle hooks are necessary

## Workflow Steps

- Instantiate the agent class (e.g., AssistantAgent)
- Invoke agent methods (e.g., answer_question)
- Session tracking begins automatically upon instantiation
- Session remains active until application exit

## Constraints

- Session persists until application termination
- No intermediate session pause or resume
- Single implicit session per application instance

## Cautions

- Ensure application termination properly closes the session
- Do not rely on explicit session.close() calls in this pattern

## Output Contract

- Agent instance created and session tracking active; session persists until application exit with no additional session management code required.

## Example Executions

### Example 1

- Input: Instantiate AssistantAgent and call answer_question method
- Output: Agent responds with answer; session automatically tracked from instantiation to app termination
- Notes: No session.start() or session.stop() calls needed
